scope: Mathematical validity of the submitted negative answer to the original background-free pointwise-covariant allocation implication on the permitted LCA class.
strongest_verified_claim: On R^2, xi=lambda_1 tensor (sum_n delta_n + 2 sum_n delta_(n+1/2)), with constant X and law concentrated on phase 0, is diffuse and locally finite; every pointwise-equivariant xi-preserving measurable allocation fixes the rooted state, including arbitrary noninjective allocations, but the original mass-stationarity identity fails with event discrepancy 2/3.
limitations: No implication for free actions, one-dimensional diffuse measures, strictly positive planar densities, independent backgrounds, or arbitrary Markovian kernels.
Spatial-a.e. covariance without a specified pointwise root representative is a different convention.
